_how_to_edit: The list of places the agent can get rental-car prices from. The agent tries them in fallback_order and stops once it has usable prices for every rental company it can reach. To add a source: make it return the source_output format (see data_source_interface.md), add one entry to sources, and put its id in fallback_order. To turn a source off, set enabled to false. Friendly names shown to users live in display_fields.json source_labels, not here.

sources.notes: Preferred source. NOT confirmed to work yet. Unknown so far: which rental companies it covers, whether it returns full fees and taxes, cancellation terms, and how fast it answers.
An agent that opens rental company websites and reads quotes, like a person would. Not built yet.
A scraping tool that pulls quotes from rental company pages. Not chosen or built yet.
Prices saved from an earlier run. Each saved option keeps its original captured_at and environment, so old prices are never shown as fresh. Where snapshots are stored is not decided yet.
Last resort. Made-up sample data, always labelled fixture and PLACEHOLDER. Never shown as real.

Optional, not in the fallback order. Prices a person typed into a file in the source_output format, e.g. real quotes copied from rental sites for the demo. The file must say its own environment: live only if the quotes are real and have a captured_at time, otherwise fixture.
